Package hadur117.micro.core

package hadur117.micro.core

    hadur117.micro
     
  • Classes
    Class
    Description
    Energy
    Bullet power and the fire gate: Figment's log10(energy) * 325 / distance (about 3 at 200 px, 1 at 650 px), capped at others / 3 + 1.9: 1.9 while fewer than three opponents remain (SAOR-8), where the end game is scored on survival and 1.9 keeps two shots of margin against a 3-power hit; 2.9 with three to five; no cap the engine does not apply itself above that.
    Movement
    Corner oscillation (MeleeSeed, as Figment runs it): the robot shuttles between two points near its nearest corner, one on each wall that meets there.
    Selection
    Target selection and the radar (Figment, Wallaby): the nearest robot, kept by name until it dies or a nearer one is scanned (SAOR-3); any death frees the target and the radar (SAOR-4); the radar spins free and is held on the target only while the gun is about to fire (SAOR-5).
    Targeting
    The gun: a per-opponent Markov chain over the target's movement state (Figment), played forward by Monte-Carlo to bullet arrival and voted into angle bins.
